creative_direction: Create a seated rabbit doll with a cream enamel body and two broad rounded ears mounted like simple rotating paddles. Turn one ear sideways while the other stays upright, producing a questioning pose without mechanical complexity. Use woven fabric at the shoulder and hip joints, short heavy feet, and a small orange nose. Keep the face restrained and original. Photograph it against muted blue-gray with soft reflections in the enamel and tiny edge imperfections. Avoid shiny plastic, sharp blades, cartoon gloves, or a familiar commercial character shape. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
